q1_quote: NVLW: only "NCDS will not arbitrate claims involving a vehicle used primarily for commercial purposes unless the 'Lemon Law' of your state covers (1) vehicles used for commercial purposes" (pdf p.14). Pre-Owned VLW does NOT cover "Any used vehicles purchased for resale purposes or used for commercial purposes (not used primarily for personal, family, or household purposes), including without limitation, pick-up and delivery services, ride-sharing, taxi, ... hauling, construction or moving services, government, military or emergency use, use by multiple drivers, etc." (pdf p.7)

capacity_floor_quote_page: "8 years or 150,000 miles ... with minimum 70% retention of Battery capacity" NVLW pdf p.5
q3_transfer_to_used_buyer: NVLW: Y, no cost. Pre-Owned VLW: only to private retail (non-commercial) purchasers
q3_transfer_quote_page: NVLW: "transferable at no cost to any person(s) who subsequently and lawfully assume(s) ownership of the vehicle after the first retail purchaser" (pdf p.4). Pre-Owned: "transferable at no cost to any private retail purchaser (i.e., for non-commercial use...)" (pdf p.5); the Pre-Owned VLW "does not extend or otherwise alter" the NVLW balance (pdf p.4)
q3_used_consumer_into_business: NVLW balance kept; Tesla Pre-Owned 1 yr/10k add-on lost
q4_upfit_body_builder_exclusion: Not covered: "Any repair, alteration or modification, including lightbar harness connection wiring, of the vehicle that was made inappropriately, or the installation or use of fluids, parts or accessories, made by a person or facility not authorized or certified to do so" (NVLW pdf p.8). No Tesla upfitter program found
fleet_use_verdict: Yes with conditions (NVLW); No for the Pre-Owned add-on
